method: Built-in imagegen, new independent generation after rejecting the initial edit as still too thick.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL transparent pixel-art animation sprite sheet of VERY THIN LIGHTNING FILAMENTS for a restrained low-saturation fantasy strategy game. 8 equal square cells, exactly 4 columns x 2 rows, 2:1 landscape canvas. IMPORTANT geometric specification: each electrical strand is a hairline with a luminous core ONLY 2-3 pixels thick in an approximately 440px-wide cell. A narrow dim edge may add 1 pixel on each side. It must look like cracked silver wire / a fine zigzag line, NOT a thick tube or broad ribbon. The widest main trunk must stay below 1.2% of cell width. Mostly EMPTY transparent space. Each full bolt has only 2 delicate side branches. No filled branching shapes. Small sharp kinks, crisp pixel steps. Palette ONLY muted silver grey, chalk-white, dusty blue-grey, faint grey lavender. ALL colors low saturation (under about 25%). Absolutely no saturated blue/cyan pixels, electric neon rims, gold, flames, cloudy halos, bubbles, stones, diffuse blobs, thick glow or ground explosion. Minimal energy sparks, tiny fine rays. Eight temporal stages in reading order: 1 a tiny 4-ray charge glint; 2 two small delicate charge arcs; 3 upper portion of thin zigzag descending; 4 a full slender vertical branched zigzag from upper-center to bottom-center; 5 a different slender main bolt with a VERY SMALL 3-ray contact spark at bottom-center; 6 lower half thin fading arcs; 7 two disconnected hairline residues; 8 a tiny fading glint. Even clean cell spacing with transparent gutters. Center all effects inside each equal cell. Full strike cells 4 and 5 reach to 85% of cell height, with clear top/bottom margins. Keep every cell independent and completely inside its rectangle. Actual transparent alpha. NO background, no grid, no text, no characters, no symbols other than electricity. Production game sprite, clean and readable when reduced to 192px per cell. Favor subtle fine linework over decorative intensity.
preparation: ImageMagick regular 4x2 crop, alpha-preserving Lanczos downsample; oxipng lossless optimization. Original source retained.
scope: Lightning textures only; timing, damage, audio, other effects and character art unchanged.
